blockingReasons.detail: Explicit initdb admin becomes bootstrap grantor for initial builtin monitoring memberships. Those entries are included in the protected memberships family but excluded from pg_dumpall membership export. Unmodified replay does not remove their admin grantor. Removing one roles row cannot satisfy the zero-grantor rule or full membership comparison. No separately proven exact grantor reconciliation exists in this proposed C2.

initdb-created plpgsql belongs to the dedicated bootstrap admin; current catalog tracks every extension owner. Ordinary builtin-extension dump policy and current owner-only ACL supplement do not restore that owner. This is a tracked extension field, not the excluded database-owner field. Single-role-row normalization cannot erase it.

Global OwnedCluster/OwnedTransport admin conversion also changes source and capture fixtures. Shared SQL helper requires postgres; fixture source would contain the reserved admin and trigger source collision; TLS helper copies socket-cluster identity while its separate TLS postmaster remains postgres; capture authorization explicitly expects postgres. A restore-only identity separation or wider fixture changes must be designed without changing capture/production authority.

Cases 07-08 establish extra-admin mismatch and cleanup constraints. Cases 14-15 use a single-cluster source/reset/restore cycle; they do not prove a newly bootstrapped dedicated-admin destination has zero tracked builtin grantor and extension-owner footprint.
